audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the final three Seed Shop event records: Harvey’s aerobics scene, Morris’s Joja coupon incursion, and all branches of Pierre’s marked-up vegetable sale. Every line, overhead reaction, embedded question, response choice, price, percentage, multiplier, business meaning, and character voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical Harvey, Pierre, Gus, JojaMart, Joja Corporation and saloon terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship and quest conditions, response IDs, numeric values, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Together with the preceding batch, all Seed Shop records are covered. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
